related.title: IBM Heron 超導量子處理器
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯；IBM Heron 超導量子處理器改以可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation; IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor centers on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Ankaa 接面與能階與transmon 能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到IBM Heron 超導量子處理器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以閘誤差與邏輯證據為起點，設計一項能區分「方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯」與「可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare ankaa junctions and levels with transmon levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from gate errors and logical evidence and propose an observation distinguishing square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation from tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control, including uncertainty.

related.title: Google Willow 表面碼系統
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯；Google Willow 表面碼系統改以碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation; Google Willow surface-code system centers on code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Ankaa 接面與能階與Willow 非諧能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Google Willow 表面碼系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以閘誤差與邏輯證據為起點，設計一項能區分「方格連通、可調耦合與原生閘編譯」與「碼距、每循環邏輯錯誤與完整系統指標」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare ankaa junctions and levels with willow anharmonic levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google Willow surface-code system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from gate errors and logical evidence and propose an observation distinguishing square connectivity, tunable coupling and native-gate compilation from code distance, logical error per cycle and system metrics, including uncertainty.
